statements.t: Our aim is to develop medicines for biologically and commercially validated targets which demonstrate a strong differentiation compared to existing therapies.

We believe data from our completed Phase 1 study supports our decision to advance PN-881 into a comprehensive Phase 2b psoriasis program, with initiation of a dose range-finding study in patients with plaque psoriasis expected in early first quarter 2027.

We also have pre-clinical stage drug discovery programs addressing biologically and commercially validated targets, including an oral IL-4R alpha antagonist for the treatment of atopic dermatitis and moderate-to-severe asthma, and amylinR-based mono- and poly-agonists for the treatment of obesity.
We expect to continue to incur significant research and development expenses, and other expenses related to our ongoing operations, clinical development and pre-clinical discovery programs.
We recognize all research and development costs as they are incurred unless there is an alternative future use in other research and development projects or otherwise.

Program-specific costs are unallocated when the related expenses are incurred for our early-stage research and drug discovery projects as our internal resources, employees and infrastructure are not tied to any one research or drug discovery project and are typically deployed across multiple projects.

As a result, we are unable to determine the duration and completion costs of our research and development projects or when and to what extent we will be able to generate revenue from the commercialization and sale of any of our current or future product candidates.

We expect to continue to incur expenses to support our continued operations as a public company, including expenses related to compliance with the rules and regulations of the SEC and those of the national securities exchange on which our securities are traded, insurance expenses, investor relations expenses, audit fees, professional services and general overhead and administrative costs.
We expect research and development expenses to increase for the remainder of the year as compared to the prior quarters in 2026.
We do not currently anticipate a need for additional funding in the near term.

We intend to fund repurchases from our cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities, as well as royalties and other payments received under our collaboration arrangements with Takeda related to MIMRYLO and JNJ related to ICOTYDE.

estimates.t: Our management’s discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations is based on our unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements, which have been prepared in accordance with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (“GAAP”).

estimates.name: Components of Our Results of Operations — License and Collaboration Revenue
estimates.t: Our license and collaboration revenue is derived from payments we receive from our collaboration partners under the JNJ License and Collaboration Agreement and the Takeda Collaboration Agreement.

estimates.name: Cost of Revenue
estimates.t: Cost of revenue represents costs incurred pursuant to a collaboration agreement entered into in June 2012 and a related arbitration resolution agreement entered into in August 2021 between us and Zealand Pharma A/S (“Zealand”).

estimates.name: Research and Development Expenses
estimates.t: Research and development expenses represent costs incurred to conduct research, such as the discovery and development of our product candidates.

estimates.name: ​ — General and Administrative Expenses
estimates.t: General and administrative expenses consist of personnel costs, allocated costs and other expenses for outside professional services, including legal, human resources, audit and accounting services.

estimates.name: Interest Income
estimates.t: Interest income consists of interest earned on our cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities, which is comprised of contractual interest, premium amortization and discount accretion.

estimates.name: Other (Expense) Income, Net
estimates.t: Other (expense) income, net consists primarily of amounts related to foreign exchange gains and losses, realized gains and losses on sale of marketable securities and related items.

statements.t: The Company also has a number of clinical and preclinical programs based on clinically and commercially validated targets and addressing unmet medical needs, including an oral IL-17 antagonist peptide, anti-obesity dual and triple agonists, an oral hepcidin functional mimetic, and the recently announced IL-4 and amylin discovery programs.

our ability to use and expand our programs to build a pipeline of product candidates
